spans.s:
mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Praised, penegyrised, hymned, glorified.
E.
ष्टु to praise, aff. क्त.

f. (-तिः)
Praise, eulogy.
E.
ष्टु to praise, aff. क्तिन्.

m. (-कः)
A bard, one who accompanies a chief or an army, to recite the titles and praises of the one, and to inspire the other by chaunting martial exploits, &c.
E.
स्तुति praise, and पाठक a reader.

m. (-तः)
A bard, a herald: see the last.
E.
स्तुति praise, and व्रत observance.

mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं)
To be praised, laudable, praise-worthy.
E.
ष्टु to praise, aff. क्यप्.

m. (-भः)
A he-goat.
E.
ष्टुभ to stop, aff. क; also read स्तभ.

(उ) स्तुम्भु r. 5th cl. (स्तुभ्नोति) 9th cl. (स्तुभ्नाति)
1 To stop.
2 To be stupid.

n. (-प्यं)
Excellence, preferableness, (in the language of the Vedas.)
E.
ष्टु to praise, क्मेप्य Uṇādi aff.

r. 4th cl. (स्तूप्यति) r. 10th cl. (स्तूपयति)
To heap, to pile, to collect; also ष्टूप.

m. (-पः)
A heap, a pile of earth, &c.
E.
ष्टूप to heap, aff. घञ्, or ष्टू to praise, प Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made long.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Being praised.
E.
ष्टु to praise, pass. v., शानच् aff.
